what: A small red wedge hanging over the big Hero title grows as you scroll down, tilts 8°, and covers the whole screen in one color (over stage height × .3 of scrolling, fully grown within the first 25% with power2.inOut — tilted bounding box width 7365px, top edge -1140px). Stage pieces switch at thresholds of the same progress value — the title disappears at .1 over .4s, the next text lines rise from 16px below at .35 with .04s stagger over .5s, and on rewind they return at .2~.3s

options.cover: Border box width (px) measured with the fully grown wedge tilted, default 7365
options.top: Top edge of the fully grown wedge outline box (stage-relative px), default -1140
options.shift: Horizontal position at the center of the fully grown wedge — from stage center (px), default -100
options.until: Share that finishes growing during scroll (0~1), default .25
options.ratio: scrub length = Stage height × ratio, default .3
options.[data-fx-part=wedge]: Wedge svg (viewBox required) — the first path, polygon or g inside grows. Color is --fx-color (default --kf-accent)
options.[data-fx-part=out][data-at]: Piece (title or background) that disappears in .4s power2.out once past the threshold (progress 0~1)
options.[data-fx-part=in][data-at]: Pieces that appear once past a threshold — from data-y (default 0)·data-x·data-scale with data-dur (.5)·data-ease (power4.out)·data-stagger (.04). Pieces at the same threshold go in sequence
options.fx:progress: Fires a progress value (detail) from the element — hook things like header hiding onto it

note: The stage is fixed with position: sticky and the element is made taller than the screen (original 100vh + 467px). 7365px is a value the original site used regardless of width
